Nehal Tulsidas Talmale

ANAPLAN MODEL BUILDER | ANAPLAN CONSULTANT | L3 CERTIFIED ANAPLAN PROFESSIONAL| Phone: +91 9834082902 | Email: talmale.nehal15@zohomail.in

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Anaplan Model Builder with 4+ years of experience in Anaplan development, model building, solution design, FP&A, workforce planning, headcount planning, expense planning, inventory planning, warranty planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, dashboard development, and enterprise planning. Certified Anaplan Model Builder (L1, L2, L3) with expertise in New UX, ALM, CloudWorks, Anaplan Connect, Data Hub, model optimization, model tuning, Agile methodology, UAT, production support, release management, stakeholder management, and Connected Planning.

CORE SKILLS & KEYWORDS Anaplan, Anaplan Level 3 Certified, Connected Planning, Data Hub, FP&A, Financial Planning & Analysis, Budgeting, Forecasting, Workforce Planning, Headcount Planning, Expense Planning, Revenue Planning, Inventory Planning, Warranty Planning, Supply Chain Planning, Demand Planning, S&OP, Scenario Planning, Variance Analysis, Driver-Based Planning, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), New UX, ALM, CloudWorks, Anaplan Connect, Model Building, Model Optimization, Model Tuning, Reporting, Dashboard Development, Data Mapping, Data Integration, Agile, Scrum, UAT, SIT, Hypercare Support, Production Support, Release Management, Stakeholder Management, JIRA, Excel.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

MResult Services Pvt. Ltd. | Sr. Software Development Engineer (Anaplan) | Dec 2023 – Present - Designed and documented requirements for Headcount Planning and Expense Planning models. - Developed scalable Anaplan solutions and configured modules, lists, actions, and dashboards. - Worked on New UX, ALM, CloudWorks, and Anaplan Connect. - Managed user access, production support, model enhancements, and deployments. - Participated in UAT, release management, and hypercare support.

Keansa Solutions LLP | Anaplan Consultant | Feb 2022 – Nov 2023 - Built Warranty Planning and Inventory Planning models. - Converted Excel-based FP&A reports into Anaplan solutions.

Managed data mapping, reporting, dashboard development, and user stories. - Developed New UX dashboards and supported integrations and model maintenance.

Bajaj FinServ | Anaplan Trainee | Dec 2021 – Jan 2022 - Created and managed Revision Tags and synchronized changes across Anaplan models. - Supported model lifecycle management and deployment activities. - Developed Wake-Up Models and assisted in model maintenance. - Created and enhanced operational reports and performance metrics. - Provided production support and resolved model-related issues. - Assisted in model enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives. - Gained hands-on experience in Anaplan model building, data management, and reporting.

SRB Construction | Site Engineer | Feb 2019 – Nov 2021 - Managed day-to-day site operations and project execution activities. - Coordinated manpower planning, resource allocation, and vendor management. - Maintained records of structural materials, inventory, and project documentation. - Monitored project schedules, budgets, and resource utilization. - Ensured compliance with quality, safety, and operational standards. - Led teams to achieve project milestones within timelines. - Generated new business inquiries and supported client relationship management. - Prepared progress reports and communicated project updates to stakeholders.

CERTIFICATIONS • Anaplan Certified Model Builder L1 • Anaplan Certified Model Builder L2 • Anaplan Certified Model Builder L3 • The Anaplan Way • FP&A Certification • S&OP Certification
